fact: On 22 December 2025 the Yaoundé II council opened a fully computerised civil-status post at the Hôpital central that immediately issued its first digitalised birth certificates; the article puts under-registration at about 34% of children.
title: Yaoundé II digitalise l'état civil : un poste avancé 100 % informatisé opérationnel à l'Hôpital central
